scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --type-check src/client.ts src/errors.ts src/index.ts src/request-options.ts src/resources
scripts.format: oxfmt --write README.md package.json tsconfig.json src/client.ts src/errors.ts src/index.ts src/request-options.ts src/resources
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check README.md package.json tsconfig.json src/client.ts src/errors.ts src/index.ts src/request-options.ts src/resources
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check-types && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build
